title: GTA 6 PC Release Date: What's Real (2027?)

beats.say: If you are waiting for GTA 6 on PC, stop refreshing. Here is what is actually known.
beats.screen: You at a PC, scrolling a store page that has no GTA 6 listing

beats.say: GTA 6 came out on November 19th, on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Only those two.
beats.screen: Console boot screens side by side, PS5 and Xbox

beats.say: Rockstar has not given PC a date. Not a month. Not a year.
The one report going around says early 2027. That is a report, not Rockstar.
beats.screen: Headline screenshot of the GamesBeat report, report label big

beats.say: And GTA 5 reached PC about a year and a half after it hit consoles.
So: no date, early 2027 is the rumour, and until Rockstar says it, stop refreshing.
beats.screen: Back to the empty store page, you close the tab
